claims.sourceText: John Greenewald, 'Space Force Says Documents on "Fastwalkers" and "Slowwalkers" All "Exempt from Disclosure"', The Black Vault, 22 December 2023, https://www.theblackvault.com/documentarchive/space-force-says-documents-on-fastwalkers-and-slowwalkers-all-exempt-from-disclosure/
claims.text: The Black Vault reports that the US Space Force, responding on 19 December 2023 to a July 2023 request for all procedures and manuals referencing 'Fastwalkers' and 'Slowwalkers', withheld the material in full under FOIA Exemption 1 and section 1.1(a) of Executive Order 13526. The response letter itself was not opened for this record.
